bosses.name: Tindalos
bosses.strategy:
Watch out for his Deathtouch attack; it takes away 75% of your HP, which
most of the time is a MAJOR inconvenience. He can also use Fire breath,
which will hit for a decent amount of damage. Make sure to keep an eye on
his physical attacks as well, as they'll quickly whittle down your HP,
hitting for over 100 to a 150 HP per string of attacks.

Have Alice be the primary healer, using Cure every round. If it's not
needed, have her use Blessed Light instead. Zhuzhen should be using Life
Sucker every round (or if you were able to level him up to 23, use Corpse
Arm instead), stopping only to help Alice heal when needed. Keith should
be using Drain Touch if he needs HP, or Bat Dance if he doesn't.

If you were able to get used to Keith's Ring enough to where you're
comfortable with him having the Mind's Eye equipped, I recommend that
over his Rituals, but still have him use Drain Touch when he needs
healed.

You'll most likely need to replenish MP and SP throughout the battle, as
it will take a while, but be patient and stay healed.

Make your way to Nina and Michelle's house in the southeastern corner. After
Nina tells you the whole story and you regain control, leave the house and head
west back to the first area. If you have the extra money, upgrade Keith's
weapon to the Royal Estoc and make sure he's properly equipped, then SAVE at
the Save Point. When you're ready, examine the lower-right door to the Mayor's
house in the upper corner. Break in?

control outside of their house. SAVE YOUR GAME, then examine the door on the
house above you (the one on the right) to find another Lottery Member!

Nothing strange about the ring here. Make sure to win the Oracle Earrings
before continuing on; it increases your max MP 20%! If you don't win it, reload
your last save and try again. Remember, you need to win something from each
member at least once!

Head over to the place where you fought Kevin for a scene. Once it's over,
check the chest to your left for a [_FLASH BADGE_], then examine the upper
right corner of the room to find a [_SEAL OF STRENGTH_] on the floor above a
cart. Once you're done there, do any shopping and preparation that you want,
then leave Bistritz and head to the Blue Castle once again.
